  plain stability, all                   0.876

  plain stability, rename only           0.841

Difference vs answer_confidence, bootstrap 95% interval:
  soft_stability   +0.076  (+0.035 to +0.123)
  soft_reorder     +0.031  (-0.006 to +0.072)
  soft_rename      +0.059  (+0.012 to +0.110)

How often variants changed the answer:
  reorder flip rate: right answers 0.060, wrong answers 0.442
  rename flip rate: right answers 0.102, wrong answers 0.636
